summary: Delta Reign's first weekend filled the feed with pull posts, from big Mega Rayquaza SIR hits to people saying the pull rates feel bad. Access is still a pain: Best Buy is running invite-only drops, and casual buyers say scalpers left them nothing to buy. On the digital side, Collector Crypt kept leading on-chain card revenue, Pump's gacha packs drew some FUD, and Topps admitted Cosmic Chrome shipped with missing Supernova cards. Solflare Packs had a small but steady stream of 'just rip' posts led by @hyperstrike, all positive.

sources_note: Data from the x connector's full-archive post search and news search, covering 09:00 UTC on 8 Nov to 09:00 UTC on 9 Nov 2026. Likes, reposts, replies, quotes and follower counts are public_metrics as returned at fetch time; impressions quoted where noted. Restock bots, preorder ads, NFT and merch spam, and the payments search (mostly crypto debit card promos) were skipped. Revenue and profit figures are third-party and unverified. No Phygitals, Watch.fun, Rip.fun, Arena Club, Disney Pinnacle, Top Shot or GameStop Power Packs posts of note in the window. Solflare's own top posts were a community teaser, not packs. New creators were checked against collector-base.csv and recent archive files.
